description.value: Planet India Restaurant is a full-service Indian dining destination self-described as voted #1 for Indian cuisine in Surrey, offering an extensive menu spanning tandoori, curries, biryanis, and breads. The restaurant provides dine-in, takeout, online ordering with delivery, and a catering service, plus a party hall seating up to 60 guests. A dedicated Veggie Delights section and several vegetarian appetizers make it a solid option for plant-based touring cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an active full-service Indian restaurant with online ordering, takeout, delivery, and catering — the business is clearly operating. The phone number on the website ((604)-594-6075) matches the OSM tag (+1-604-594-6075). The website claims the restaurant is 'Voted #1 Restaurant of Indian Cuisine in Surrey,' while the OSM community is filed as 'Tsawwassen'; coordinates 49.1339419, -122.839023 fall in the Newton area of Surrey, not Tsawwassen, suggesting a community mismatch. No bike-specific amenities (parking, rack, pump, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM community is filed as 'Tsawwassen' but coordinates (49.1339419, -122.839023) and the website's own claim of being 'Voted #1 in Surrey' both indicate the restaurant is in Surrey (Newton area), not Tsawwassen.
No street address present in OSM tags or recoverable from the fetched website content.
None of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is active and has cyclist-relevant offerings (takeout, vegetarian menu), but none of the three required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. Additionally, the OSM community tag ('Tsawwassen') appears incorrect given the coordinates and the restaurant's own Surrey attribution, so the listing needs geographic verification before inclusion.
